Everett responds by demanding a more truthful relationship. He binds himself to secrecy, learns that Max also operates as Seth Pendell and Joshua, sees evidence of Max's dragon connection, and receives most of Max's history and statistics. He then commits Golden Axe's support to the tower ascent. Max still withholds his private dragon agreement. The party must also protect Tanila's royal identity, Fowl's exceptional hammer, its five artifact components, Max's crafting role and inner entity, and the dragon tooth. The elven campaign against Max, the unknown poisoner, the artifact mystery, and the tower climb remain unresolved.
recaps.in_short: Max leads Fowl, Tanila, Batrire, and new ranger Cordelia through a rapid tower ascent while hiding abilities and rewards that could make them targets. He secretly becomes the legendary weaponsmith Joshua, survives assassination attempts, and uses his inner entity's powers to overcome bosses and protect the group. The party wins exceptional equipment, bonded artifact components, and a temporary tower boon, while Golden Axe provides training, materials, and political cover. Tanila reveals her elven royal nature to Max, and he tells her how his inner entity has changed. After reaching tower level 14, the group kills a Gorgon, gains petrification cures, and restores two long-missing Golden Axe members. Public attention forces a reckoning with Everett, who binds himself to secrecy. Max then reveals his identity and most of his history, but keeps his private dragon agreement concealed. Everett promises to protect the secret and support the unfinished climb.

recaps.text: Previously: Fowl, Tanila, and Batrire were Max's established companions, and Alexander was their innkeeper ally.

Golden Axe learns that Max's party is progressing through the tower at an abnormal rate, with yellow gems appearing far more often than expected. Everett orders secrecy, but an explosion at the faction workshop interrupts the climb and leaves a dwarf crafter dying. At the dwarf's request, Max ends his suffering, then accepts legendary weaponsmithing and rare armor-crafting abilities offered by Consume. Cordelia, a level-54 elf ranger, joins as the party's fifth member after Tanila reveals enough of her hidden royal nature to secure the newcomer's silence. Cordelia helps Max, Fowl, Tanila, and Batrire hunt two rare lizard-man enemies on the first floor. The second battle nearly kills Fowl when freezing magic overwhelms him, but Batrire keeps him alive and Max discovers a way through the caster's defense. Both rare enemies fall. The group gains unusually advanced equipment, including a bonded ring for every member that increases statistics by ten percent. Cordelia chooses loyalty to Tanila and the party, and the five complete the first floor while agreeing to hide the scale of their growth and rewards.

After reporting only part of their success, the five climbers receive Golden Axe housing and permission to push ahead. Everett and Tom support the plan but warn that rapid advancement will attract dangerous attention. On the second floor, a garden of hostile plants, Max combines sonar, mass pulls, and area attacks with Tanila's magic while Fowl holds enemies and Batrire covers emergencies. The approach produces many gems, but an enormous plant blocks the exit. Its seeds, roots, and vines injure Max and trap Fowl, and a barrier prevents retreat. Max survives with Batrire's healing, severs the creature's stem, and finishes dismantling it. The reward gives Fowl a defensive ring, while Consume grants Max more strength and constitution. The party clears the floor in a single day and pauses to recover. Tanila warns Max that his overwhelming contribution risks leaving the others behind, so he agrees to make more room for the group's skills. They also consider a long-term strategy of surrendering tower levels for permanent bonuses, then reclearing early floors with superior equipment.

During the party's rest, Max buys a disguise necklace and becomes Joshua, secretly practicing his new weaponsmithing skill in Zach's forge. He creates exceptional bonded hammers for teenage assistant Brian and for Zach, binding both to secrecy. An unseen pursuer then tracks Max through the city, and a poisoned bottle nearly kills him during dinner with Tanila. His inner entity takes control long enough to save him and warns that powerful enemies have found him. Max returns to training, defeats Golden Axe warrior Grace, and leads the party onto a werewolf-filled third floor. At the central enclosure, a giant werewolf's intimidation disables Fowl and Cordelia while a larger horde approaches. Max summons a demon with his own blood. His inner power compels the demon to accept a bargain to kill the enemies and protect Max's allies. Together they defeat the boss and the surrounding horde. Max releases the demon after it promises secrecy and future aid. The victory leaves him with an unexplained key and an enduring, uncertain connection to the summoned creature.

The key opens a rare tower chamber whose scaled host grants one temporary boon. The party chooses Fowl, who receives a bonded golden breastplate with enormous defensive bonuses that will last until he can enter the tenth floor. With Fowl newly strengthened, the group completes the third floor and advances into an undead graveyard. Disease clouds and fire-producing skeletons complicate the fighting, but Batrire supplies cures and Fowl's armor lets him hold the front. The party defeats a large red skeleton boss and reaches the exit. Back at Golden Axe, Max learns that the workshop disaster left the faction short of elite crafters. He offers to introduce an independent craftsperson who wants materials, privacy, and freedom from ordinary membership obligations. Disguised as Joshua, Max works in the faction forge for about twelve hours and produces a legendary ice dagger. Everett and Tom accept Joshua as an anonymous legendary weaponsmith and agree to give him access to ranked materials, never realizing that their new contractor and Seth are the same person.

The party undertakes its first tower boss route on a desert floor. After learning to destroy the moving cores of sand golems, the group enters an arena dominated by an enormous sandworm. Tanila devises a plan to trap its mouth around Batrire's barrier, allowing Max to attack from inside. Acid nearly destroys his body, but potions, improvised dilution, Batrire's strongest healing, and Demonic Teleportation keep him alive. The wounded worm dies from its own acid. Cordelia receives Elemental Shot and Poison Arrow from the rewards and is formally assured that she belongs to the party as an equal. Soon afterward, attackers fire on Max in the city. His upgraded sonar lets him block the bolt, pursue the ambushers, and capture one elf while another escapes. Captain Vela takes the prisoner into custody. Tanila drains his mind for information, then directs Max to kill him. She learns that further attacks are planned and that an elven royal daughter hostile to humans and dwarves appears to be directing the wider campaign. The immediate attacker is dead, but the larger threat remains beyond local authority.

As Joshua, Max crafts more legendary weapons for Golden Axe but still cannot find materials suitable for his dragon tooth. His inner entity unexpectedly helps with a difficult elemental infusion. The party resumes climbing through a minotaur settlement and uses walls, ranged attacks, and terrain to break a tunnel rush and drive more than a hundred attackers into a deep shaft. At the bottom they enter a sealed boss chamber containing an armored, one-horned minotaur. The creature's flaming club and ground attacks overwhelm ordinary defenses, and it charges Tanila after resisting Fowl's taunt. Max teleports into the strike and is gravely injured, while Fowl uses a one-charge ring from Tom to draw the boss away. Once recovered, Max combines demonic movement, Magical Strike, and Rampage to sever the creature's damaged leg, allowing the group to finish it. Consume grants him further physical power and a rare mental defense. Max claims the boss's bonded flaming club, and the chest yields a gem capable of carrying the entire party, including fallen members, out of the tower. The group survives and reaches level 55 with a new emergency escape option.

Max and Tanila compare their growing strength, though Tanila privately conceals that her bracelet can reveal royal power and double her attributes. The party clears a dangerous forest and a desert-pyramid floor, then Tom halts its rush toward the next boss and imposes focused training. He brings in Dexic, a senior Golden Axe climber, to test Max. Dexic's disciplined technique exposes weaknesses in Max's melee fundamentals. During the spar, her sword unexpectedly fails to injure him, and Max reveals that he can store the weapon after touching it. Dexic breaks his ribs and arm before Tom stops the match. In Everett's office, further tests confirm that ordinary blades slide harmlessly off Max's body. Everett dismisses Dexic to limit the secret, though she demands answers later. Max then tells Everett and Tom that Seth and Joshua are one person. He explains that a dragon encounter placed binding promises on him and shows them a dragon tooth that only he can craft. The two Golden Axe leaders now know his crafting identity and dragon-related secret, but not the wider truth behind his abilities.

Everett permits Max to continue limited work as Joshua and promises Golden Axe support beyond the fiftieth floor, while warning that the next level is exceptionally lethal. The party enters an ice castle, learns to defeat blue giants with fire, precision shots, and controlled terrain, then is sealed into deep snow with a much larger boss. Its fear effect disables Fowl and Cordelia, its ice storm threatens the three ranged companions, and it repeatedly restores itself from the surrounding snow. Max resists the fear, interrupts the storm by breaking the creature's armor, and climbs onto it using his mobility and defenses. He destroys its head faster than it can regenerate, burning his flaming club down in the process. The reward chest supplies powerful bonded equipment for all five climbers. Each member also receives a black box that bonds permanently to its owner. Max's inner entity identifies these as artifact components and says every person needs four before their purpose can be explained. It also warns that anyone who learns of them may hunt the group. The party completes this set of tower floors and returns to Golden Axe carrying a new secret shared by all five members.

Golden Axe celebrates the party's return, although Dexic continues watching Max for answers. Everett establishes a crafting quota that exchanges faction materials for Max's work, and Max creates a legendary healing staff for Batrire. The party farms early floors to tower level 10, then spends seven days trapped in a dark maze where light attracts flying creatures that bombard the camp. After escaping, it receives short-duration escape rings and enters another dark floor filled with giant bats. Max carries all four companions through the final stretch before the lights fail, and the group emerges with enough experience to bring Cordelia to level 60. On floor 12, a misplaced torch activates an invulnerable stone guardian inside a runic arena. Physical attacks accomplish nothing, so Max rapidly tests rune sequences while Cordelia records each attempt and Batrire struggles to keep Fowl alive. The correct sequence destroys the guardian and opens the barrier. Max gives its earth core to Golden Axe. Afterward, Tanila and Max discuss their unequal lifespans, and she signals that a concealed royal matter is ready to be revealed.

Tanila removes her suppressing bracelet and shows Max her elven royal form. She explains that it doubles her attributes and exerts increasing compulsive authority over other elves, creating grave danger if her parents learn of their relationship. Max responds by explaining that his inner entity has become a more cooperative guide in crafting and magic. He then makes Fowl a secretly exceptional vampiric hammer. The party clears two mechanism-based floors and reaches tower level 14, but its speed prompts Golden Axe to reduce visible support. On the fifteenth floor, the climbers discover a coliseum filled with petrified victims and identify the boss as a Gorgon. Max leads by sonar while everyone avoids its gaze. The creature fights with blades, acid, regeneration, and petrifying venom. Tanila and Cordelia attack when it turns away, and Max and Tanila burn the snakes on its head before trapping it between walls. Max kills the Gorgon, but its poison begins turning him to stone. Consume grants poison immunity in time to purge the venom, and Max survives the battle exhausted but alive.

The Gorgon's chest contains equipment for every party member and petrification cures. Using Golden Axe records, the group identifies a dwarf warrior among the statues and restores him after decades of imprisonment. It then finds and revives a human woman who had been petrified for about eighty years. Both long-missing members return to the faction, and two cure potions remain. News of the Gorgon victory becomes public, so Tom spreads a false account claiming the party used a mirror against it. The cover story cannot stop growing scrutiny of the group's speed. Everett confronts Max and insists that continued Golden Axe membership requires a more truthful relationship. He binds himself with magic that can punish disclosure lethally, and Max responds by sharing most of his history, statistics, concealed power, and dragon evidence. Max identifies himself as Max Host, the same person known as Seth Pendell and the weaponsmith Joshua, but withholds his private agreement with the dragon. Everett accepts the remaining boundary, promises secrecy, and commits his support to the party's unfinished tower ascent.

characters.description: The leader of a five-person tower party, also called Seth Pendell by his companions. He combines close combat with defensive stone magic while directing the group through the revived floor-19 boss.
characters.name: Max

characters.description: A principal ranged caster in Max's party and his partner. She helps control dangerous enemies while the group survives the unusual floor-19 boss encounter, contributing magic from behind the frontline defenders.
characters.name: Tanila

characters.description: The party's dwarf shield warrior and frontline defender. He holds dangerous enemies away from the group's ranged fighters and healer during the floor-19 battle, relying on his shield and durability to protect his companions.
characters.name: Fowl

characters.description: The dwarf healer and defensive support in Max's five-person party. Her restorative and protective abilities help keep the group alive through the floor-19 boss, its revival, and the destructive blast that follows.
characters.name: Batrire

characters.description: An elf archer and precise ranged fighter in Max's party. She identifies vulnerable growths on the floor-19 boss and lands an important attack on the purple cube that keeps rebuilding it, helping the group halt its revival.
characters.name: Cordelia

characters.description: The leader of Golden Axe and a sponsor of Max's party. He coordinates faction resources, tracks rewards offered for restored Gorgon victims, and seeks board support for Tanila's future advancement as the climbers prepare for higher floors.
characters.name: Everett

characters.description: Golden Axe's materials manager, responsible for overseeing the faction's crafting supplies.
characters.name: Alfreda

characters.description: An unidentified dragonkin who knows Max's name and petitions system gatekeepers on his behalf. The visitor spends power to improve his chances of receiving valuable future items, but gives no clear motive.
characters.name: Dragonkin visitor

characters.description: A Golden Axe trainer and operational leader. He mobilizes faction teams during a manticore dungeon break and emphasizes that closing the dungeon is the priority.
characters.name: Tom

characters.description: A dangerous autonomous presence bound to Max and associated with his unusual powers.
characters.name: Inner entity

characters.description: A Golden Axe fighter who remains behind to protect wounded climbers after an elven ambush in the tower. Her fate is initially uncertain as the survivors reach the exit without her and report that hostile elves still hold the field.
characters.name: Dexic

characters.description: Tanila's father, an exceptionally dangerous figure who can painfully compel even his resistant children to obey. His unexplained power appears to be a red skill, leaving Max's inner entity uncertain that it could protect him against the threat.
characters.name: Tanila's father

characters.description: Tanila's father and the elven king. Tanila identifies herself as his third daughter while confronting the Mind Reaver, placing the offstage ruler at the center of her concealed royal history and the painful memories raised by the encounter.
characters.name: King Cervantes

characters.description: An elven ruler whose attendance turns Max and Dexic's Coliseum duel into a major public event. She controls the selection of their opponents, draws a large crowd to the arena, and represents the faction challenging Golden Axe.
characters.name: Elven queen

characters.description: A queen who formally witnesses the expanded Coliseum challenge arranged by Max. She helps confirm the terms under which the original team match will be followed by two solo fights, all conducted without healer-provided recovery for Max.
characters.name: Macy

characters.description: A queen who formally witnesses and confirms Max's expanded Coliseum challenge. Her authority makes the wagers and unusual sequence of three matches an official public confrontation between Golden Axe and Enlightened Souls.
characters.name: Molly

characters.description: An unidentified assassin observing the Coliseum while searching for a way to kill Max. The hunter cannot measure his strength, knows he has survived poison, and delays the next attempt while looking for a weakness.
characters.name: Hunter

characters.description: The ruler and champion of an underwater city. He doubts that Max's group truly consists of tower climbers and requires Max to prove the claim in an unarmed arena duel where skills remain permitted, taking the role of champion himself.
characters.name: Merfolk king

characters.description: Max's real identity, disclosed to Cordelia after his survival in the merfolk duel forces an explanation. He tells her that his concealed black skill can sometimes take abilities from those he kills, bringing the entire party into his confidence.
characters.name: Max Host

recaps.ending: Max, Tanila, Fowl, Batrire, and Cordelia return to Golden Axe after killing the floor-39 kraken. They have cleared the path to floor 40, and the whole party now knows that Max is Seth Pendell, that his real name is Max Host, and that his black skill Consume can take abilities and attributes. Golden Axe is wealthier and better protected, while Everett and Tom continue supporting its growth without knowing Max's central secret. Tanila remains magically bonded to Max and threatened by her royal family. The inner entity's origins and increasing strength are unresolved, as is its suspicion that higher powers have altered the party's tower floors. Molly's agreement has checked direct attacks from Enlightened Souls, but the wider political danger remains. The apparent assassination campaign also continues after Max survives a targeted red-portal trap. As the party prepares for floor 40, an unknown attacker transports Max away from Golden Axe and confines him alone in a dark stone room. His captor, location, and immediate fate are unknown.
recaps.in_short: Max leads Tanila, Fowl, Batrire, and Cordelia from floor 19 through floor 39 while Golden Axe grows around their victories. Their route includes increasingly strange mechanical floors, an elite ifrit, the Mind Reaver, underwater trials, sea raiders, and a kraken. Tanila reveals that she is King Cervantes's daughter, defeats the Mind Reaver with her dangerous red skill, and becomes magically bonded to Max. Max and Dexic win a public Coliseum challenge that forces a temporary settlement with Enlightened Souls, but an assassin remains at large. Max's inner entity grows stronger and suspects that higher powers are interfering with the tower. Cordelia finally learns that Max is Seth Pendell, that his real name is Max Host, and that Consume lets him take abilities and attributes. After surviving a targeted red-portal trap and defeating the kraken, Max returns to Golden Axe ready for floor 40. An unknown attacker then abducts him into a sealed stone room.

recaps.text: Previously: Max, known to his companions as Seth Pendell, leads a tower-climbing party with Tanila, Fowl, Batrire, and Cordelia. Tanila is his partner, Fowl serves as the shield-bearing frontline fighter, Batrire is the healer, and Cordelia attacks from range. The group is supported by Golden Axe under Everett's leadership and trained by Tom. Max conceals unusual powers connected to a dangerous autonomous presence within him. The party has already restored two people who had been petrified by a Gorgon. As this volume begins, the group is advancing through the tower and carrying secrets that could attract powerful enemies.

Max's party survives an unusual floor-19 boss that revives through a purple cube, then claims powerful bonded equipment. An unidentified dragonkin has secretly spent power to improve Max's future item chances, while Max repeatedly senses an unseen observer near the tower. A manticore dungeon break interrupts the climb. Max directs new Golden Axe teams to protect civilians while his own party closes the dungeon, though two adventurers die. A practice match with Tom shows that Max can already contend with an established climber. On floor 20, fire-spitting insects and beam-firing dragonflies lead to a queen-bee swarm too dangerous to fight, so Max carries everyone to safety. He then negotiates a conditional alliance with the inner entity: it will help during crises, and he will permit limited opportunities that do not harm those he protects. The entity denies making the tower harder and warns that Max's continued growth will draw dangerous attention.

The party enters a metal city populated by armed goblins, dwarves, and self-repairing machines. Max's hidden Consume ability takes Alchemy, ranged weapon expertise, engineering, and power-core knowledge from defeated enemies. Everett agrees that the new crafting abilities must remain secret. The party then clears volcanic floors while preparing for a Coliseum dispute caused by an elven ambush on Golden Axe climbers. Dexic survives the ambush after staying behind to protect the others, and Max volunteers to fight beside her. Inside the tower, an elven delegation tries to force him out of the contest and brings stealthed assassins. Max kills one attacker. Tanila then exposes concealed royal authority by compelling the remaining elves, who reveal that members of her family are involved. The party nevertheless chooses an elite floor-25 portal and faces a fire-immune ifrit. Max permits his inner entity to take control during the final assault, and it kills the boss with power and precision beyond what Max normally displays.

The ifrit's chest gives the party exceptional equipment and more rare materials. Max crosses natural strength and constitution milestones and secretly gains a survival skill that can prevent a killing blow. Fowl and Batrire reaffirm their intention to marry in the dwarven capital. Golden Axe celebrates the party's rapid completion of twenty-five floors, and Dexic accepts Max as her Coliseum partner. The next tower levels contain coordinated ogres and trolls that bypass the frontline, use terrain, and attack in organized groups. Golden Axe grows as the party's reports and materials become valuable. An ant floor ends with a distressed queen whose hive mind has malfunctioned for unknown reasons. Max later creates his first charged power core, but his inner entity warns that the approaching boss is exceptionally dangerous. On that floor, a Mind Reaver takes control of Fowl, Batrire, and Cordelia. Max restrains them while Tanila crosses the creature's barrier alone after activating her own long-suppressed Mind Reaver power.

Tanila absorbs the Mind Reaver's attacks and identifies herself as the third daughter of King Cervantes. The encounter forces her through memories of her father's coercion and a possible future ruled by hunger for power, but she rejects that path and kills the boss. The reward gives Fowl, Batrire, and Cordelia protection against mind control. Max and Tanila join matching necklaces that combine their bonuses, cannot be separated, and will break if either dies. Max then uses his concealed engineering and magical crafting knowledge to forge a powered sword for Dexic. At the Coliseum, he expands the original team duel into three matches: he and Dexic will face a pair, after which Max will fight two more opponents alone without outside healing. Queens Macy and Molly confirm the terms. Max's aim is to make attacks on Golden Axe costly and to expose the elven queen to political consequences if her champions lose.

An unidentified hunter watches the Coliseum and postpones an attempt on Max after failing to assess his strength. In the arena, Dexic kills one elven champion while Max kills the other, then defeats both solo opponents. During one fight he allows the inner entity to take control, producing a deliberately public warning to those threatening Tanila or Golden Axe. Macy and Molly later try to compel Max and discover that his hidden power resists them. Molly accepts his peace proposal: Golden Axe returns some spoils and bodies, while Enlightened Souls must stop targeting the faction or face repeated challenges. The party resumes climbing through mechanized goblin, ant, golem, and animal floors. Golden Axe gains wealth, recruits, protected housing, and plans for a secure crafting complex. The increasingly anomalous tower route troubles Max and Tom. In a dream, the entity is identified as the red-eyed double that appears to Max. It suspects that powerful beings noticed the unprecedented weapon Max crafted and may be influencing the floors, though it has no proof and believes any interference is limited.

The party crosses a long mechanized forest and then a trap maze before confronting a huge flesh-and-metal boss armed with electricity, incendiary launchers, harpoons, and self-repair systems. They blind it, exploit its repair openings, and survive its final explosion behind layered defenses. The five-person reward chest grants remarkable bonded equipment and large power crystals. Max receives boots that raise every attribute and can periodically reset all his cooldowns, along with black ore suitable for a future dragon-tooth project. He also creates a legendary bow that generates its own magical arrows. The group then begins a water-themed run of floors, fighting across shifting sandbars and training with Tom for underwater combat. On a submerged floor, armed merfolk escort the party to their fortified city. Their king doubts that they are genuine tower climbers and challenges Max to an unarmed duel in an underwater arena, revealing that the ruler is also the city's champion.

The merfolk king repeatedly increases his power and lands what should be a fatal strike, but Max's hidden survival skill saves him. Max forces the king to yield, then gives his former opponent a healing potion. The king accepts the party, offers to guide it onward, and rewards Max with bonded clothing that permits normal movement, breathing, and combat underwater. Max's survival makes further secrecy impossible within the group. He tells Cordelia that he has a black skill capable of taking abilities from those he kills. Tanila also explains that he is Seth Pendell and that his real name is Max Host. Cordelia accepts the explanation and joins the rest of the party in guarding the secret. Everett meanwhile warns that tower enemies grow sharply stronger at each tenth-floor band. The five climbers then enter another sea floor on a self-sailing ship, united by knowledge that remains concealed from Golden Axe's wider membership.

The party repels hundreds of sea raiders, assaults their fortress with the ship's cannons, and triggers a hybrid sea boss by destroying a flag. Fowl's reflected-damage aura delivers the killing blow while Batrire keeps the group alive through the barrage. After receiving upgraded equipment, the party returns to training and helps Golden Axe recruits develop their combat technique. Two undead dungeon breaks then occur at once. Everett sends Dexic with the other four party members while Max handles a separate break alone. Max enters an unexplained red portal and defeats a vampire, a lich, and a shadow-moving third opponent before escaping. His inner entity concludes that the encounter was a targeted trap arranged through another world traveler and warns that the hostile force remains active. Max nevertheless clears the second break as well and is publicly honored with a statue at the city gate, increasing the contrast between his celebrated position and the hidden campaign against him.

On floor 39, the party reaches an island arena where a rapidly regenerating kraken guards a puzzle of paired orbs and pedestals. Completing parts of the mechanism summons armed ships. Tanila develops a plan that combines those ships, explosive barrels, cannon fire, magic, and sustained burning to stop the creature from healing. Max uses the merfolk king's gift to move across the water, and the whole party coordinates the final attack that kills the kraken. The reward includes permanent-stat potions. Max gives his potion to Fowl and tells Cordelia that Consume also grants attributes, completing her limited understanding of his secret. The group returns to Golden Axe after clearing floor 39 and prepares to begin floor 40. Before that ascent starts, an unknown attacker abruptly transports Max away from the faction into a dark, sealed stone room. The party remains behind, and Max's location, captor, and immediate fate are unresolved.

characters.description: Now living in Forks and deeply in love with the vampire Edward Cullen, Bella turns eighteen as the book opens. She is troubled by growing older while Edward stays forever young, and she continues to wish to be made a vampire so she can be with him permanently. Introspective and stubbornly loyal, she is happiest among the Cullens and dreads any future in which she is separated from Edward.
characters.name: Bella Swan

characters.description: The vampire Bella loves, one of the animal-feeding Cullens. Protective to the point of control, he is deeply reluctant to let Bella risk her humanity or her safety, and refuses to change her into a vampire. His fear of the danger his world poses to her governs his choices as the book begins.
characters.name: Edward Cullen

characters.description: Bella's father and the police chief of Forks. Reserved and well-meaning, he worries about his daughter's intense attachment to Edward and, later, about the depression that overtakes her. He is relieved when she seems to find comfort in an old family friendship.
characters.name: Charlie Swan

characters.description: The Quileute teenager from La Push whom Bella has known since childhood. Warm, cheerful, and openhearted, he becomes Bella's closest friend after a period of loss, spending hours with her rebuilding a pair of old motorcycles. His easy company gradually pulls her out of despair, and his feelings for her deepen beyond friendship.
characters.name: Jacob Black

characters.description: The Cullen family's compassionate physician father, who stitches Bella's arm after an accident at her birthday party. Calm and humane, he embodies the family's effort to live without harming humans.
characters.name: Carlisle Cullen

characters.description: Bella's closest friend among the Cullens, a small, energetic vampire who can see glimpses of the future in visions shaped by people's decisions. She hosts Bella's birthday party at the start of the book. Her foresight later proves pivotal, though it has notable blind spots.
characters.name: Alice Cullen

characters.description: One of the Cullens and Alice's partner, still the family member who struggles most with the temptation of human blood. At Bella's birthday party a small accident with a paper cut overwhelms his control, triggering the crisis that follows.
characters.name: Jasper Hale

characters.description: A tall, older youth from the La Push reservation who leads a close-knit group of local boys. He finds Bella when she is lost and unresponsive in the woods and carries her safely home. Authoritative and watchful, he and his followers are regarded warily on the reservation, and he holds some hidden role among the Quileute.
characters.name: Sam Uley

characters.description: One of the nomad vampires from before, dark and courteous in manner, who had once left James's coven. He finds Bella alone in a meadow and reveals that he has been in contact with Victoria, who wants Bella dead. Tempted by Bella's scent and no longer restrained by the Cullens' presence, he moves to kill her himself.
characters.name: Laurent

characters.description: The red-haired vampire whose mate, James, was destroyed by the Cullens. She returns to the area seeking revenge, intending to kill Bella. Elusive and cunning, she is hunted through the forests by the local wolves but repeatedly slips away.
characters.name: Victoria

characters.description: One of the three ancient leaders of the Volturi, the powerful, tradition-bound coven that enforces vampire law from the Italian city of Volterra. Delighted by talent and unfailingly courteous, he can read every thought a person has ever had with a touch. He takes a particular interest in Bella and the Cullens.
characters.name: Aro

characters.description: Jacob's father, a Quileute elder and old friend of Charlie's, who uses a wheelchair. Guarded around the Cullens, he is quietly aware of the tribe's secrets and watches developments at La Push closely.
characters.name: Billy Black

recaps.ending: Bella saves Edward from the Volturi in Volterra, and the couple reunites, their love reaffirmed after months of grief and misunderstanding. The Volturi decree that Bella cannot stay human indefinitely: she must be transformed into a vampire or killed, and they intend to check that it is done. Back in Forks, Edward confesses that leaving was an attempt to protect her that nearly destroyed them both. The Cullen family votes and largely supports changing Bella, and Edward agrees to do it himself, but only if she will marry him first, hoping to give her the human experiences he thinks she is sacrificing. Two dangers remain open as the book closes. Victoria is still hunting Bella and has not been caught. And the ancient treaty between the Cullens and the Quileute wolves forbids any Cullen from biting a human, so Edward's promise to change Bella threatens to break the truce and set the vampires and werewolves, including a heartbroken Jacob, against each other.
recaps.in_short: After a birthday accident convinces Edward that his vampire world endangers Bella, he leaves Forks with his family, plunging Bella into a deep depression. She slowly recovers through a close friendship with Jacob Black and discovers that reckless danger lets her hear Edward's voice. She learns that Jacob and his friends are werewolves who protect the tribe from vampires, and that they are hunting Victoria, who wants Bella dead in revenge for her mate James. When Bella cliff-dives and nearly drowns, Alice's visions lead Edward to believe Bella has died, and he travels to Italy to provoke the vampire rulers, the Volturi, into killing him. Bella and Alice race to save him. Reunited, they are spared by the Volturi on the condition that Bella eventually become a vampire. Edward admits he never stopped loving her; the Cullens agree she may be changed, deepening the rift with Jacob.

recaps.text: Previously: Bella Swan moved to the rainy town of Forks and fell in love with Edward Cullen, discovering that he and his adoptive family are vampires who feed on animals rather than people. Edward loved her in return despite the danger her scent posed to him. A nomadic tracker vampire, James, hunted Bella for sport and bit her before the Cullens destroyed him; Edward drew the venom out to keep her human. Bella emerged devoted to Edward and eager to become a vampire herself so they could be together forever, though Edward refused to change her. James's red-haired mate, Victoria, escaped, her thirst for revenge unresolved. Bella had also renewed a childhood friendship with Jacob Black of the nearby Quileute reservation.

At Bella's eighteenth birthday party, hosted by the Cullens, a small paper cut sends Jasper lunging at her blood, and Bella is hurt in the scramble to hold him back. Shaken by how close his family came to killing her, Edward concludes that his world is too dangerous for her. Days later he takes Bella into the woods and tells her he no longer wants her, then leaves with his entire family, disappearing from Forks. Bella, believing she has lost him and the future she wanted, is left devastated and alone.

Bella sinks into a deep, months-long depression after Edward's departure, going through the motions of life while feeling hollow. She is briefly lost in the forest before a reservation youth, Sam Uley, carries her home. In time she reconnects with Jacob Black, and their growing friendship slowly revives her. Together they restore two old motorcycles, and Bella discovers that reckless, dangerous acts make her hear Edward's voice in her mind, a sensation she comes to crave. She deliberately courts danger to keep hearing him, while leaning on Jacob's steady warmth.

Jacob abruptly grows distant and falls under Sam Uley's influence, leaving Bella hurt and confused. Alone in the forest, she is confronted by Laurent, a vampire who reveals that Victoria is hunting her for revenge and who then tries to kill her himself. A pack of enormous wolves drives him off. Bella soon learns the truth: Jacob and Sam's group are shape-shifters, werewolves whose ancient purpose is to protect the tribe from vampires, and they are now hunting Victoria as she stalks the area. Jacob and Bella's bond deepens even as the danger around her sharpens.

Craving Edward's remembered voice, Bella leaps from a high cliff into the sea and nearly drowns before Jacob rescues her. Alice Cullen, who can see the future, glimpses Bella jumping and, believing her dead, returns to Forks. Through a tragic misunderstanding, Edward comes to believe Bella has died, and, unable to bear existing without her, resolves to end his own life by provoking the Volturi, the ancient vampire rulers, into destroying him. Alice and Bella race to Italy to stop him before he steps into sunlight before a crowd and forces the Volturi's hand.

Bella reaches Edward in Volterra just in time to stop him from stepping into the sunlight, and the two are reunited, each having believed the other lost. The Volturi leaders, especially Aro, spare them but rule that Bella, a human who knows too much about vampires, must eventually be turned into one of them or destroyed. Edward and his family return to Forks, and Edward confesses that he never stopped loving Bella and left only to protect her. The Cullens vote, and most agree that Bella should be allowed to become a vampire, which Edward reluctantly accepts on the condition that she marry him first. But peace is fragile: Victoria is still at large, and the treaty between the Cullens and the werewolves forbids the Cullens from changing a human, straining Bella's bond with Jacob.
